# How Ibexlabs Optimized AWS Co-Selling with Automation and Data Synchronization for Spacelift

Spacelift sought an expert cloud solutions provider to initiate and optimize co-selling on the AWS Marketplace. Labra facilitated the seamless listing of Spacelift's software on the AWS Marketplace and established automated bidirectional data sharing between AWS ACE and CRM systems. This enhancement in collaboration and reporting capabilities empowered Spacelift to effectively track and optimize co-selling efforts, managing 50 to 100 deals each quarter with improved efficiency.

![65bcf1406ba4bc77223cfabb Logo Spacelift.io 1](https://www.ibexlabs.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/65bcf1406ba4bc77223cfabb_Logo-Spacelift.io_-1.png)

- About


## About Spacelift.io

[Spacelift.io](http://www.spacelift.io/) provides a collaboration and automation layer for infrastructure as a code. They focus on openness, flexibility, and customization aiming for sophisticated and security-conscious power users.

Spacelift works with any IaC setup and is capable of working as a self-hosted agent on your infrastructure, therefore offering maximum security without sacrificing the functionality. Their solution is built on top of well-known and well-loved open source components like Docker and Open Policy Agent, allowing full customization while maintaining sensible defaults.

## The Spacelift.io Cloud Commerce Journey – Highlights:

- Got up and running with AWS Co-Selling in a matter of weeks.
- Leveraged [Labra.io’s](http://labra.io/) quick and easy customer support enabling different types of automation based on inputs for different opportunity types.
- Empowered leadership team with additional reporting from within Salesforce with metrics like – the number of AOs, registered and launched opportunities.
- ‍ [Labra](https://www.linkedin.com/company/labra-io/) eliminates the need for manual copying and pasting between ACE And CRM systems, thereby streamlining sales operations at scale.
- Increased velocity – Managing 50 to 100 deals each quarter, with improved collaboration.

Here’s Ryan Cartwright, VP of Strategic Growth at Spacelift sharing how he and his team leverage Labra for more efficient Co-sell management with AWS.
